weather.name: Clear
weather.text: The sky is clear from one edge to the other.
weather.remark: Good walking weather. Let us use it.

weather.name: Overcast
weather.text: Low grey cloud sits over everything like a lid.
weather.remark: Grey all day by the look of it.

weather.name: Heat
weather.text: The air is heavy and still, and the road throws the heat back up at you.
weather.remark: Keep the water skins full. This will get worse.

weather.name: Fog
weather.text: Fog lies in every hollow, and anything more than a spear's length away is a guess.
weather.remark: Stay close. I cannot see ten feet in this.

weather.name: Rain
weather.text: Steady rain, the kind that finds its way in at the collar.
weather.remark: We will be wet to the skin by noon.

weather.name: Snow
weather.text: Snow comes down thick and quiet and fills the road behind you.
weather.remark: Watch the road. It will be gone under this soon.

weather.name: Ash-fall
weather.text: Grey ash drifts down out of a sky the colour of pewter.
weather.remark: Cover your mouths. That is not snow.

weather.name: Thunderstorm
weather.text: The storm breaks overhead: rain in sheets, and lightning close enough to taste.
weather.remark: That sky is going to break. We need a roof, or we need to make one.

weather.name: Blizzard
weather.text: The blizzard comes in sideways. You cannot see your own hands.
weather.remark: If we are caught out in this, we will not walk out of it. Shelter. Now.

weather.name: Ash-storm
weather.text: The mines breathe out, and the sky goes black with hot grit that scours skin and fills the lungs.
weather.remark: The mines are breathing out. Get under cover, all of us.

indoors: The fire burns down to embers. Somewhere a door creaks and settles.
Rain on the roof, and the roof holds.
Nobody sleeps well, but everybody sleeps.
outdoors: The night is cold, and the watch is long.
Something moves at the edge of the firelight, and thinks better of it.
Stars come out between the clouds, few and far.
pc: I will take first watch. Get some sleep.
Wake me if anything comes. Anything.
wake: Morning comes grey and cold, and you are all still here.
Somebody has made tea. It is terrible. It is wonderful.
